integrity: Self-contained proof and standard-library reproducibility script; finite experiments are only checks, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic p prime at least 7; third power of a binary quartic and a distinguished middle degree. Extra nonharmonic zeros of the determinant and all Jordan blocks are not classified; generic means geometrically generic over an algebraic closure. No independent mathematical audit.
title: Harmonic cross-ratios force a sharp modular quartic multiplication-rank jump
